heard: Zillah gave birth to a new son, Cain was built in his first city Lamech took two wives for his own, one named Adah, the other Zillah Adabor, Jabal, the nomad, father of those with tents and flocks Jubal played the lyre and pipe, father of all who hear the song Tubal Cain forged the metal tools out of bronze and iron bright He shaped the hammer and the tongs under the heavy weight of night His sister Nama stood beside, name recorded in the old genealogy Tubal lived among the tanks, Tubal played the ancient melody To Vulcain, forge the metal to
